name: IndicGLUE: Indian Language Natural Language Understanding Benchmark
description: IndicGLUE is a comprehensive natural language understanding (NLU) benchmark suite covering 11 major Indian languages. Built by AI4Bharat, it encompasses diverse tasks including Natural Language Inference (NLI), Sentiment Analysis, Named Entity Recognition (NER), Question Answering, and Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval, serving as the standard evaluation testbed for multilingual Indic language representations.
